title: 客户合并付款，银行有扣费
requirement: 原币资金与多单核销守恒，费用另有依据，未解释差额待处理。

environment.identity: local OIDC issuer of the test (RS256, typ at+jwt, JWKS by discovery); no real identity provider

actors.config.reviewer: 配置与交易档案发布人（独立复核）
actors.cost.checker: 核价复核（核实、评估、冻结）

chain: BRC-001: the S3 chain and D1 §5 steps 1–17 to export lot lot.1 (shipment.1 documented, its documents released)
observed: 合并付款: 1,000.00 remitted for order.1 P2 672.00 and legacy SO-LEGACY-0007 328.00 (opening receivable); received 980.00, charges 15.00 stated; difference 20.00 unexplained; 672.00 applied to order.1; the legacy 328.00 → FUND_DIFFERENCE_UNEXPLAINED (Only 308.00 USD is available: 20.00 USD of the difference is unexplained)
费用另有依据: treasury's own resolution → PERMISSION_DENIED; credit.manager.1 resolves 15.00 as bank_charge on the advice; 323.00 applied to the legacy receivable; 5.00 more → FUND_DIFFERENCE_UNEXPLAINED
守恒: remitted 1,000.00 = received 980.00 + resolved 15.00 + unexplained 5.00 (pending); applied 995.00 = 672.00 (order.1, open 0) + 323.00 (legacy, open 5.00); exposure 5.00
not_executed: China customs (single window): submissions and receipts are recorded manually by the documentation clerk (CN-M01); the receipts' original texts are synthetic
the tax authority: invoices are synthetic scans imported and verified by tax.officer; refund declarations, approvals and payments are recorded from synthetic evidence
the bank: fund records are entered by treasury from synthetic bank advices
the carrier's, forwarder's and inspection agency's systems: bookings, B/Ls and reports are entered from EVD evidence
a real identity provider (the test's local OIDC issuer mints every token)
the user interface (中文操作 is outside the API repository)
deviations: "多单": the composed BRC-001 world holds one Brant order, so the second order is a legacy order imported at the cutover as an opening receivable (C10); the combined application rule is the same for both receivables
refusals: 409 FUND_DIFFERENCE_UNEXPLAINED /api/brant/v1/stl/commands/application.apply by treasury (CN-AT07: one remittance for two orders)
403 PERMISSION_DENIED /api/brant/v1/stl/commands/fund.resolve_difference by treasury (CN-AT07: the bank charge resolved independently)
409 FUND_DIFFERENCE_UNEXPLAINED /api/brant/v1/stl/commands/application.apply by treasury (CN-AT07: the bank charge resolved independently)
chain_refusals: 409 CONVERSION_SLOT_CONFLICT /api/brant/v1/trd/commands/order.prepare by sales (有效订单唯一)
404 NOT_FOUND /api/brant/v1/trd/orders/order.2 by sales (有效订单唯一)
409 PURCHASE_ALLOCATION_EXCEEDED /api/brant/v1/pur/commands/purchase.draft.prepare by purchaser (有效订单唯一)
404 NOT_FOUND /api/brant/v1/pur/purchase_drafts/purchase.2 by purchaser (有效订单唯一)
409 PURCHASE_DRAFT_COMMITTED /api/brant/v1/pur/commands/purchase.draft.void by purchaser (§5 step 8: PUR purchase commitment)
